watches.name: Dána 141 - Dress Watch
watches.description: Before a ship could be built in Belfast, it had to be drawn. Dána 141 is a dress watch for the people still doing that part: the architects, designers, makers and chefs who start with a line and finish with something that didn't exist before. It is a slim steel rectangle, 28.0 × 39.6mm and just 8.3mm thick, cut to the proportions of a draughtsman's sheet. It is Art Deco in spirit rather than costume. We've borrowed the movement's optimism and discipline (geometry, symmetry, light, precision) and left the 1930s where they are. Why 141? 141 isn't a model number. It's the ratio. The case follows 1:√2, roughly 1:1.41, the proportion of a drawing sheet. Fold a sheet in half and the shape stays the same, which is why the proportion has lasted. At 28.0 × 39.6mm, Dána carries that geometry onto the wrist. Design details Octagonal cartouche. The dial sits inside an octagonal frame, like a plan on a drawing board, or the title block of a technical drawing, mounted and lit. Pinstripe centre panel. It reads two ways: starched drafting linen, or the cut of a draughtsman's suit. Chamfered case facets. Cut steel plate, the yard's material, dressed for evening. The case is 316L stainless steel, brushed and polished, under an anti-reflective sapphire crystal. Built in Belfast Nomadic exists to put Belfast on the watchmaking map. We build in the city, close to the work, so the people making your watch are people you can talk to. Dána is the clearest version of that so far: a design drawn from the city's shipyard drawing offices, made in the place that drew them. Strap and fit Dána comes on a variety of straps from The Strap Tailor, 20mm at the lugs tapering to 16mm at the buckle, with a brushed stainless buckle included. It's 4.5mm thick at the lugs, tapering to roughly 2.5–3mm, so it sits flat under a cuff. Three lengths are available: S (110/65mm), M (120/70mm) and L (130/80mm)

watches.name: Nomadic X Colin Geddis - StageTimer
watches.description: The Stagetimer reflects Nomadic’s belief that the best watches do more than tell time — they tell stories, capturing moments, mindsets, and personality in a lasting form. Developed in collaboration with Northern Irish comedian Colin Geddis, the aim was to create a custom timepiece that went far beyond a simple dial or colour change. Instead, the project was built around a clear objective: to design a watch that feels unmistakably “Colin”, while remaining fully aligned with the Nomadic design language.

watches.name: Céad 126 - Crimson Dawn - Chronograph
watches.description: Céad is the Irish word for ‘first’ - a fitting name for our debut chronograph. It celebrates milestones in Irish motorsport and honours legendary riders. The number 126 marks a lap speed record of 126mph, set by our ambassador Glenn Irwin at the North West 200 - making him the first to break the 125mph barrier. It’s also a subtle tribute to Joey Dunlop’s 26 victories at the Isle of Man TT. Created for those who embrace opportunity and lead from the front, Crimson Dawn is aimed at individuals who are ready for action. It's a colourway that brings a little more presence to the wrist while maintaining the sophistication and versatility that define the Céad 126.

watches.description: The road falls silent for a moment before the start - that charged stillness where history waits to be rewritten. Then, in an instant, everything changes. Engines roar, speed takes over, and the pursuit of "First" begins. Created to mark Nomadic's partnership with the North West 200 as the 'Official Timing Partner', this limited release of just 50 chronographs is more than a watch.

watches.name: Brú 750 - 42mm Ti5 Deep Dive - Emerald Abyss
watches.description: Brú is the Irish word for pressure. At 750 metres of water resistance, this is the deepest rated watch we have ever created. Crafted from marine and aerospace - grade titanium, with a screw-down crown and solid case back, it is engineered to withstand immense forces with quiet confidence and total reliability. ISO 6425 certified, meaning it has been tested for reliability under extreme conditions, making it a true dive watch. Emerald Abyss takes the green of Belfast Lough on a cold morning, deepening to near-black below the surface. It's the Brú for people who like their depth rating with a bit of the harbour's colour.

A rich green dial is paired with gold-plated indices and hands: for a refined balance of heritage and performance. Hallmarked by the British Assay Office, certifying the purity and authenticity of every 18k gold component.

watches.name: Ltd Edtn - British & Irish Watchmakers Day (7pcs) - Céad 126 Chronograph
watches.description: Celebrating the spirit of British watchmaking and the craft that defines these storied isles, our 2026 British Watchmaking Limited Edition is a tribute to heritage, precision, and considered design. Strictly limited to just 7 individually numbered pieces , this exceptionally rare release will debut at this year’s British Watchmaking Day Show, with any remaining pieces made available online shortly after. Based on our celebrated Cead 126 chronograph , this special edition features striking sub-dials in a selection of our signature colours; Ocean Blue, Navigator White, and Crimson Red, a refined nod to British identity, expressed through balanced colour and purposeful design. No waiting list. No repeats. Just seven opportunities to own a truly exclusive chapter of Nomadic watchmaking.

specsRaw.BPH: 28,800 Dial Lume Swiss Grade X1 BGW9 Superluminova® Strap Custom hand-stitched Strap Tailor Badalassi Rally Strap
specsRaw.The Story -: Born from Belfast’s legacy of engineering and endurance, the Céad Chronograph celebrates precision under pressure, a tribute to those who measure moments, not minutes.
specsRaw.The Case -: Machined from solid 316L stainless steel and finished with a mix of brushed and polished surfaces, the case balances strength with subtlety, built to withstand decades
specsRaw.The Dial -: A dial built for legibility and depth, with layered indices, recessed sub-registers, and luminous detailing, with a subtle nod to Belfast innovation. Designed to command attention without demanding it.
specsRaw.The Movement -: At its heart beats the Sellita SW500 M-a - a Swiss chronograph calibre renowned for reliability, accuracy, and refined mechanical craftsmanship.
specsRaw.The Strap -: It comes on a Custom hand - stitched Badalassi Wax Rally Strap by The Strap Tailor available in Brown & Black or upgrade to our Steel Aerolink bracelet.

watches.name: Céad 126 - Black Shamrock Limited Edition
watches.description: The Céad 126 Black Shamrock Limited Edition: a 40mm Swiss mechanical chronograph, finished for St Patrick's Day and built around Nomadic's three values of Exploration, Discovery and Progress. A Watch With Character The shamrock is so closely linked with Irishness that many have forgotten where it comes from. In the 5th century, St Patrick used its three leaves to explain the Holy Trinity to non-believers. More than fifteen centuries later, our own dubh seamróg, the Black Shamrock, carries a trinity shaped not by legend but by the values that define Nomadic: Exploration. Discovery. Progress. Three principles, one in every leaf, and the foundation of this limited collection. Movement: Inside is the Sellita SW500 M-a D4, a Swiss chronograph calibre built on one of watchmaking's most trusted foundations. It has 21 jewels, a 28,800 vibrations-per-hour beat rate, a 58-hour power reserve and a cam-operated mechanism designed for durability and servicing, plus hacking seconds and a quick-set day/date. Craftsmanship: Each Céad 126 is individually crafted by one of our watchmakers, then assembled, regulated and tested for the reliability Nomadic prides itself on.

specsRaw.The Céad 126 Black Shamrock Limited Edit: a 40mm Swiss mechanical chronograph, finished for St Patrick's Day and built around Nomadic's three values of Exploration, Discovery and Progress.

watches.name: Cíor 928 - Ocean Blue with diamonds - Luxury Sports Watch (36mm)
watches.description: Cíor is an Irish word meaning “to search”. It is a tribute to adventure, ambition, and pushing beyond limits. Inspired by Mary Lady Heath, the fearless Irish aviator who united refinement with record-breaking flight, the Cíor 928 celebrates a spirit of exploration that defined an era. In 1928, she became the first woman to fly solo from Cape Town to London, captivating the world with both courage and style. Designed for those who share that same drive for discovery - the Cíor 928 is built to carry you wherever the journey leads. Named for the water she crossed again and again: a steady, confident blue built for everyday wear.

watches.name: Blackout Fíor 555 - GMT Watch (41mm)
watches.description: Fíor - meaning “true” in Irish, is a reminder of your roots. Because no matter where you’re from, or how far you go, home will always be home. Belfast sits at roughly 54°34′ North, 5°55′ West, and “555” highlights the 5°55′ West longitude - anchoring the watch’s identity to where we’re from. Blackout is the Fíor at night: an all-black build with the yellow GMT hand as its one point of colour, ticking off home time while everything around it stays dark. It's the quietest way to travel between time zones.

Inspired by Mary Lady Heath, the fearless Irish aviator who united refinement with record-breaking flight, the Cíor 928 celebrates a spirit of exploration that defined an era. In 1928, she became the first woman to fly solo from Cape Town to London, captivating the world with both courage and style. Designed for those who share that same drive for discovery - the Cíor 928 is built to carry you wherever the journey leads. Takes its colour from first light over the runway, the moment before takeoff when the sky turns from grey to rose gold.

watches.description: The 401 Club Edition – A Timepiece Distilled with Legacy Crafted exclusively for members of Titanic Distillers’ 401 Club, this bespoke edition of our Marai 401 pays tribute to two Belfast icons — shipbuilding and spirits. Built in the shadow of the Harland & Wolff cranes, this timepiece is a celebration of craftsmanship, heritage, and the enduring spirit of Belfast.

watches.name: British & Irish Watchmakers Day (50pcs) - Fior 555 GMT Watch
watches.description: Inspired by the famous cola based soft drink, this limited edition timepiece celebrates everything great about the watchmaking industry on these storied isles we're privileged to call home. Limited to just 50 individually numbered pieces, they will be available exclusively at the show in London, 8th March 2025. A small amount of stock will be made available online from 7pm 8th March. This limited edition features a crisp white dial that's almost silver in certain lights and a muted red and blue 24 hour bezel. With a 41mm case, Dual time zones, and 56 hour power reserve, the Fior 555 will ensure that no matter where you're from, or how far you go, home will always be home. All stock will go live online, right here at 7pm GMT. No second chances. Just one shot to own a piece of Nomadic history.

watches.name: Amber Army Pitch-Master - Football / Soccer Timing Watch - Carrick Rangers FC
watches.description: Amber Army Pitch-Master The Ultimate Football Timing Watch – Carrick Rangers FC Crafted for football enthusiasts and professionals alike, the Amber Army Pitch-Master blends precision engineering with the proud legacy of Carrick Rangers FC. Designed to excel both on and off the pitch, this timepiece features: Match-Timing Bezel : A custom-designed timing scale on the bezel, allowing you to effortlessly track 45-minute halves, with the amber section and minute increments to keep precise tabs on critical extra time. Bold Amber Accents : Paying tribute to the club's iconic colors, the vibrant amber details stand out against a robust and stylish matt black backdrop. Durability for Every Matchday : Engineered with rugged materials to handle the intensity of game day and the adventures beyond. Whether you're timing the match, supporting from the stands, or celebrating victory, the Amber Army Pitch-Master is your ultimate companion. A Window to Precision Now equipped with a stunning sapphire caseback , the PitchMaster reveals its intricate inner workings, including a distinctive rotor design inspired by the propellers of the SS Nomadic and RMS Titanic. It's a tribute to engineering excellence—both past and present and a nod to the maritime past and present of Carrickfergus. Ready for Action The newly engineered bracelet , complete with the MicroGlide™ clasp , allows for instant, on-the-fly adjustments. Whether you're strapping it over a wetsuit or wearing it for everyday adventures, this innovative feature ensures unparalleled versatility.

watches.name: Turas 914 - Landfall - Expedition Watch (39mm)
watches.description: The Turas 914 is rooted in one of the most extraordinary survival stories in modern history. Named after the Irish word for journey , it draws inspiration from the 1914 Endurance expedition and the resilience of the men who refused to surrender to the elements. When Shackleton’s ship was crushed by Antarctic ice, it was not strength alone that carried the crew home, it was resolve, discipline and belief in the journey ahead. The Turas 914 carries that same spirit.

watches.name: Custom Engraving
watches.description: A Nomadic watch tells so much more than just the time. It tells a story and collects memories over a lifetime. Personalise your Nomadic with a custom message on the case back and start the story today. Every Nomadic watch can be personalised with custom caseback engraving — a name, date or short message, added in our Belfast workshop. Email info@nomadicwatches.com with the watch and wording you have in mind, and we'll confirm options and pricing. Engraved orders take 2-3 extra business days to ship and, being personalised, are final sale — though your lifetime warranty still applies.
